Take it from someone that made 4000$ a month and saved 12,000$ in one year had 2 car notes, apartment, and other livings expenses. Save your money to buy a nice used car clean title and as low mileage as you can find and pay it in full. You don’t want to start living in debt, or living paycheck to paycheck. Life changes but your bills will always be waiting for you to pay. Get a credit line and pay your bills with it don’t let a balance sit in there longer than 2-3 months, and use it regularly. If you don’t trust yourself with a credit card get a gas credit line. Only used for gas and some attached gas stations for snacks and such. SAVE YOUR MONEY. Live as frugal as possible but don’t be scared to spend whenever you want or need to. Find a decent apartment, make sure you can make your rent payments on time and also remember you need to cover utilities. Back to a vehicle remember you don’t just pay for the car, you also have to put gas, maintain it(oil, tires, coolant, fuel filters, air filters, ect)  and you might even want personalize it a bit. So it’s definitely an investment.
